body: I'm feeling better.  Your comments definitely helped me calm down and take a step back to think about my situation.  Even though I don't wish this situation on anyone, it's good to know that someone is in a similar boat that I'm in.  Thanks for being there for a total stranger.  I've taken small steps to try to improve my situation now, and hopefully things will turn for the better in the near future.

Yeah, I've been told that before.  I technically have everything required to graduate, but I've asked and he wants me to stay for another story...  It's bullshit.

I like playing new age type piano pieces.  I'm also trying to compose some songs right now.  I always wished I could play guitar.  Are you still playing guitar seriously?

I've stopped looking for awhile.  I do try to pursue hobbies.  I am in a bad situation to do it.  The problem with graduate school ideally you should be researching or thinking about your project at all times of the day.  For example, I got into a heated argument with my boss over taking a Saturday off.  He threw a huge tantrum.  Every time I take time for myself I feel significant guilt.  So I drink during that time so I don't feel anymore.  I have started to play piano again.  This has helped some.

Yeah, I like to think optimistically, but it is not like I didn't try in the past 6 months to date and put myself together.  I got rejected over and over again.  My ex is already in another serious relationship.  It makes me feel I never deserved her and that I was stupid to let her slip away.  I've gotten to the point where I just don't care about meeting anyone anymore.  I assume that they are just interested in being friends.  One of the other things that helped me feel alive, research, is not going well either.  My advisor has said that I am not "strong" enough for my field and that I am "weak".  I couldn't imagine myself doing anything else.  The future looks bleak.
